Andersen to host Cope North exercise with Japan, Australia

By Kenneth Quinata The Guam Daily Post

HAGÅTÑA — Hundreds of airmen from Japan and Australia will arrive at Andersen Air Force Base next week for Cope North, the annual multilateral exercise that tests how allied air forces respond to disasters and conflict in the region.

The exercise runs through Oct. 15 and will include humanitarian assistance drills on Tinian and Rota, according to a release from the 36th Wing.

Residents near Yigo can expect increased aircraft noise during daytime hours.
